item.title: What Edu is reading this week (Sep 19 - 26, 2026)
item.description: Two frontier model releases shared the week with a widening set of small decision models and agent runtimes, and with more reports on how coding agents are changing day-to-day development. Jev is still trending — second week running — with benchmark tooling, an open implementation and drop-in skills for moving the small decisions off the frontier models. On the infrastructure side: kernel live-update work to keep VMs running, DRBD releases, router and Android tooling, and a Playdate app for watching live air traffic.

item.title: What Edu is reading this week (Sep 12 - 19, 2026)
item.description: Agent infrastructure dominated the week: Kubernetes-native harnesses, a high-density sandbox runtime on GKE, and a 27B model compressed into under 6 GB. Alongside that, BSD filesystem work, PipeWire audio tooling and a batch of retro-gaming archives. AI, Agents & Tools llmman - Runs any agent on any model, with the models themselves stored and shipped as OCI images. Mecatl - Stacklok’s open source, cloud-native harness for agents: the agent loop, the sandbox and the state are separate components, so a fleet runs on Kubernetes instead of on your laptop.

item.title: What Edu is reading this week (Sep 5 - 12, 2026)
item.description: A quieter week than the last one: open-weight audio tooling, Kubernetes checklists and Helm scanning, BSD install write-ups, a batch of homelab and SDR projects, and the Omarchy funding and vulnerability-disclosure threads. AI, Agents & Tools hexgrad/Kokoro-82M - An 82M-parameter open-weight text-to-speech model, small enough to run locally and to fine-tune. santinic/audiblez - Generates audiobooks from EPUB e-books chapter by chapter, using Kokoro for the voices. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash - The smallest model in DeepSeek’s new architecture family, with native visual understanding and faster inference.
